description:
## Goal

Decouple `NoLock` from acceptance evaluation in workspace-sandbox so locking and acceptance are fully orthogonal concerns, per the locked auditability contract.

## Locked contract reference

See `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract/conclusion.md` Finding 4 M1 and the mirror at `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/docs/AUDITABILITY_CONTRACT.md`. The contract defaults `lock=false` and treats acceptance as an independent gate over apply eligibility regardless of locking.

## Specific code site

`scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/sandbox/service.go` (around lines 1146-1147) explicitly states: "When noLock is true, all files are automatically accepted (no acceptance rules apply)." Remove that conditional. Acceptance allow/deny rules MUST be evaluated against every candidate apply regardless of `NoLock`.

## Required outcomes

- `NoLock` controls only mutual exclusion / reservation. It has no effect on acceptance evaluation.
- Acceptance allow/deny rules are evaluated identically whether `NoLock` is true or false.
- Multiple concurrent sandboxes over the same scope can coexist (per `lock=false` default) and acceptance still gates each independently.
- Agent-manager can still request locking explicitly for workflows that need exclusivity, without that choice changing acceptance behavior.
- Out-of-acceptance changes do not auto-apply silently in either lock mode; they are retained as `state=pending-review` provenance (see the auto-apply-defaults item for the writer side).
- API docs, config defaults, and tests reflect the decoupled semantics.

## Expected deliverables

1. Workspace-sandbox code change at `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/sandbox/service.go` removing the `noLock`->accept-all shortcut and any related branches.
2. Updated config defaults / docs in `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/config/config.go` clarifying `DefaultNoLock` is independent of acceptance.
3. Agent-manager request behavior updated so it no longer relies on accidental acceptance bypass semantics.
4. Regression coverage (assumption tests under `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/sandbox/**`) proving acceptance filtering still applies with `NoLock=true`, including the multi-sandbox-same-scope case.
5. Documentation note in workspace-sandbox so future contributors do not reintroduce this coupling.

## Key references

- `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/sandbox/service.go` (lines 1146-1147 specifically)
- `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/config/config.go`
- `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/orchestration/run_executor.go`
- `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract/conclusion.md` (Finding 4 M1)
